description: Add short-form ad text layouts to a finished video, exact text in the brand color, clear of the TikTok/Reels/Shorts UI: hook (title over the first seconds), callout (lower-third label), review (stars, quote, name), progress_bar, countdown (ticking timer), price_tag (new price, old one struck through), offer ("50% OFF" badge) and end_card (logo, headline, button, web address over the held last frame). Pass video_url plus any of them; one call does all. 2 credits.

callout.description: Lower third: a benefit ("Ships in 24h") or a name and title. style label (default) is a brand-colored box sliding in; classic is the broadcast strap, an accent bar beside a bold name and a lighter title (bottom band on 16:9).

subtitle.description: Optional second line (the title, for classic).

color.description: Brand color as #RRGGBB: the badge and the button. Defaults to #FFE500.

countdown.description: Urgency timer under the offer badge; the digits tick down each second.

label.description: Words above the timer. Default "Ends in".

end_card.description: End card held after the last frame.

url.description: Web address shown under the button.

hook.description: Hook title over the first seconds, the overlay that decides whether people keep watching. 5-8 words.

offer.description: Offer callout: a badge that pops in on cue (after the hook when there is one).

subtext.description: Small line under it, e.g. "This week only".

price_tag.description: Tilted sticker on the left: new price big, old price struck through.

progress_bar.description: A thin bar in the brand color across the top that fills as the video plays.

review.description: Review card: stars, a short quote and a name.

quote.description: The review text, without quote marks.

video_url.description: The video to brand (MP4 or MOV).

name: pixeldojo_overlay
title: Add offer or end card
